# netbox_config_context_profiles (Data Source)

Lists NetBox config context profile objects (`/api/extras/config-context-profiles/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_config_context_profiles" "all" {}

output "profile_names" {
  value = data.netbox_config_context_profiles.all.items[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/config-context-profiles/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `data_file_id` (Number) Data File. References `netbox_data_file`.
- `data_path` (String) Path to remote file (relative to data source root).
- `data_source_id` (Number) ID of the Data Source (`netbox_data_source`).
- `data_synced` (String) Data Synced.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `schema` (String) A JSON schema specifying the structure of the context data for this profile.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `url` (String) Url.
